high_level_description: The image features a single black shoe with a distinctive design. The shoe has a sleek, modern look with a smooth upper and a low profile. It is positioned against a bright lime green background, which contrasts sharply with the dark color of the shoe, making it stand out prominently. On the side of the shoe, there is a small, square, neon green patch with a stylized eye logo in the center. This logo appears to be a simple, circular shape with an inner circle, giving it a minimalist yet recognizable appearance.
